title: High-Scoring IELTS Collocations
description: Cụm từ kết hợp tự nhiên (Collocations) Band 7.0 - 8.5 nâng cấp Lexical Resource cho Writing và Speaking.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự khác biệt/bất đồng rõ rệt
meanings: An obvious, striking, and unacceptable difference or inconsistency between facts, figures, or claims.
examples: Financial auditors uncovered a glaring discrepancy between reported corporate profits and actual tax returns.

words.general_translation_vi: Tác động sâu sắc
meanings: An extremely great, deep, or transformative effect on a situation, person, or development.
examples: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence is having a profound impact on tertiary education.

words.general_translation_vi: Gây ra mối đe dọa nghiêm trọng cho
meanings: To create an imminent danger, hazard, or risk of harm to someone or something.
examples: Rampant deforestation and habitat fragmentation pose a serious threat to endemic biodiversity in tropical rainforests.

words.general_translation_vi: Đóng vai trò nòng cốt/then chốt trong
meanings: To be of central, decisive, or crucial importance in the success or development of something.
examples: Dedicated mentors play a pivotal role in nurturing intellectual curiosity and resilience among disadvantaged students.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự tương phản rõ rệt
meanings: An extremely clear, sharp, and undeniable difference between two people, situations, or ideas.
examples: The luxurious living standards in high-rise penthouses stand in stark contrast to the surrounding suburban slums.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu hẹp khoảng cách
meanings: To reduce, connect, or overcome a divide or difference between two diverse groups, standards, or concepts.
examples: Subsidized vocational training programs help bridge the gap between academic theory and practical workplace skills.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở đường / tạo tiền đề cho
meanings: To create favorable conditions or make preparations that enable future progress and innovation to happen.
examples: Groundbreaking genetic research has paved the way for highly personalized treatments for chronic diseases.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm sáng tỏ điều gì
meanings: To provide clarity, explanation, or new knowledge that helps people comprehend a complex subject.
examples: Recent archaeological excavations have shed light on the sophisticated trading networks of ancient Southeast Asia.

words.general_translation_vi: Rút ra kết luận
meanings: To formulate an opinion, deduction, or judgment after evaluating all relevant evidence and facts.
examples: Researchers must avoid drawing hasty conclusions before replicating experiments across diverse demographic groups.

words.general_translation_vi: Hoàn cảnh bất lợi, nghịch cảnh
meanings: Unfavorable, hostile, or challenging conditions that hinder normal progress or well-being.
examples: Resilient communities demonstrate remarkable solidarity and adaptive ingenuity when confronted with adverse circumstances.

words.general_translation_vi: Đáp ứng các tiêu chí
meanings: To satisfy all required standards, rules, or prerequisites set forth for a particular opportunity or status.
examples: Candidates who meet the stringent academic criteria will be shortlisted for competitive international research fellowships.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải pháp thay thế khả thi
meanings: A realistic, practical, and workable option that can successfully substitute for another.
examples: High-speed rail networks offer a viable alternative to short-haul domestic flights, substantially cutting carbon emissions.

words.general_translation_vi: Vấn đề cấp bách
meanings: An urgent matter, dilemma, or challenge that demands immediate political or societal intervention.
examples: Addressing severe groundwater depletion has emerged as the most pressing issue for municipal authorities in arid zones.

words.general_translation_vi: Bằng chứng thuyết phục
meanings: Convincing and strong facts that lead people to believe that something is true.
examples: Scientists have presented compelling evidence demonstrating the direct link between urban air pollution and childhood asthma.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiến hành nghiên cứu thực nghiệm
meanings: To carry out systematic investigation based on observable and verifiable scientific evidence.
examples: Sociologists must conduct empirical research before proposing comprehensive reforms to the national welfare system.

words.general_translation_vi: Gieo rắc nghi ngờ về
meanings: To cause people to feel uncertain or question the truth or reliability of something.
examples: Flawed data collection procedures cast doubt on the overall validity of the clinical research findings.

words.general_translation_vi: Chứng minh / củng cố luận điểm
meanings: To provide solid evidence or facts that prove a statement or assertion is correct.
examples: The author cited numerous peer-reviewed journals to substantiate the claim that remote working boosts overall productivity.

words.general_translation_vi: Xác thực / củng cố các phát hiện
meanings: To provide additional information or evidence that supports and confirms scientific observations.
examples: Independent clinical trials are currently underway to corroborate the promising initial laboratory findings.

words.general_translation_vi: Chứng minh mối tương quan
meanings: To show a clear, measurable connection or mutual relationship between two variables.
examples: Epidemiological surveys demonstrate a strong correlation between high refined sugar intake and cardiovascular disorders.

words.general_translation_vi: Phân biệt rạch ròi giữa
meanings: To recognize or identify a meaningful difference separating two similar ideas or things.
examples: Linguists draw a sharp distinction between passive language comprehension and active conversational fluency.

words.general_translation_vi: Đạt được sự đồng thuận
meanings: To come to a general agreement or shared opinion among all members of a group.
examples: After protracted negotiations, international delegates reached a broad consensus on greenhouse gas reduction targets.

words.general_translation_vi: Bằng chứng không thể chối cãi
meanings: Facts and proof that are impossible to disprove, contradict, or reject.
examples: Satellite tracking provided irrefutable evidence of unlawful commercial fishing in protected marine reserves.

words.general_translation_vi: Cân nhắc lợi và hại
meanings: To carefully evaluate the advantages and disadvantages before making a significant decision.
examples: Governments must carefully weigh the pros and cons of nuclear energy prior to authorizing facility construction.

words.general_translation_vi: Thận trọng, cẩn giác
meanings: To act carefully and mindfully to prevent possible danger, mistakes, or mishaps.
examples: Financial analysts advise retail investors to exercise extreme caution when purchasing volatile speculative assets.

words.general_translation_vi: Đưa ra giả thuyết
meanings: To construct or develop a proposed explanation based on preliminary observations.
examples: Before initiating laboratory experiments, molecular biologists must formulate a testable scientific hypothesis.

words.general_translation_vi: Tăng thêm độ tin cậy cho
meanings: To make an argument, theory, or statement seem much more plausible and trustworthy.
examples: The newly discovered historical manuscripts lend strong credence to eyewitness accounts of the ancient siege.

words.general_translation_vi: Châm ngòi cho cuộc tranh luận
meanings: To provoke, incite, or initiate heated discussion and differing perspectives.
examples: The introduction of automated grading algorithms has sparked a vigorous debate on educational fairness.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm nền tảng / trụ cột cho lập luận
meanings: To support, validate, or form the foundational basis of a rational argument or theory.
examples: Extensive macroeconomic data underpin the author's argument regarding the cyclical nature of market bubbles.

words.general_translation_vi: Vấn đề khẩn cấp, cấp bách
meanings: Something that requires immediate action, prioritization, and resolution.
examples: Municipal authorities must reinforce aged coastal sea walls as a matter of absolute urgency.

words.general_translation_vi: Là minh chứng rõ ràng cho
meanings: To serve as tangible evidence proving the reality, value, or excellence of something.
examples: The monumental architecture of ancient Rome bears testimony to extraordinary civil engineering capabilities.

words.general_translation_vi: Không còn nghi ngờ hợp lý nào
meanings: Proven with such certainty that no rational individual would dispute the outcome.
examples: Forensic toxicology proved beyond reasonable doubt that the local drinking supply was tainted by chemical runoff.

words.general_translation_vi: Bị xem xét / soi xét kỹ lưỡng
meanings: To become the subject of detailed, critical, and close inspection by officials or the public.
examples: Corporate executive bonus packages have come under intense scrutiny in the wake of financial bailouts.

words.general_translation_vi: Bằng chứng xác thực / mang tính kết luận
meanings: Proof that is decisive, indisputable, and finishes all doubt or debate.
examples: Archaeologists discovered conclusive evidence proving that agriculture arose independently in several world regions.

words.general_translation_vi: Bằng chứng mâu thuẫn / trái chiều
meanings: Information or facts from opposing sources that contradict each other.
examples: Evaluating the impact of screen exposure on toddlers remains difficult because of conflicting scientific evidence.

words.general_translation_vi: Cấu thành hành vi vi phạm
meanings: To amount to or be officially recognized as an infraction of a law, treaty, or ethical code.
examples: Dumping untreated sewage into international waterways constitutes a flagrant violation of environmental law.

words.general_translation_vi: Yếu tố mang tính quyết định
meanings: A critically essential element that directly dictates or strongly influences an eventual result.
examples: Consistent parental encouragement is a crucial factor determining long-term academic motivation in young learners.

words.general_translation_vi: Vượt xa mọi kỳ vọng
meanings: To perform or turn out vastly better than anyone originally anticipated or predicted.
examples: The grassroots literacy initiative defied expectations by enrolling twice as many adult learners as anticipated.

words.general_translation_vi: Mang lại kết quả hữu hình
meanings: To produce real, measurable, and observable improvements or practical benefits.
examples: Taxpayers legitimately expect municipal infrastructure expenditures to deliver tangible outcomes in daily commuting times.

words.general_translation_vi: Xua tan những hiểu lầm
meanings: To eliminate false beliefs, erroneous assumptions, or myths through objective evidence.
examples: Public healthcare campaigns must actively dispel misconceptions surrounding the transmission of infectious pathogens.

words.general_translation_vi: Phổ biến thông tin
meanings: To broadcast, distribute, or spread data and advice widely to a designated audience.
examples: Emergency broadcast systems disseminate critical evacuation advice during typhoons and catastrophic floods.

words.general_translation_vi: Thiết lập tiền lệ
meanings: To create an initial standard or landmark decision that serves as a guide for future similar circumstances.
examples: The landmark court decision established an important legal precedent protecting whistleblowers from institutional retribution.

words.general_translation_vi: Không đạt kỳ vọng
meanings: To fail to achieve the required, hoped-for, or anticipated level of quality or success.
examples: The newly inaugurated public transit extension fell short of expectations due to frequent signaling breakdowns.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo đà, tăng tốc phát triển
meanings: To increase steadily in speed, intensity, influence, or popularity over time.
examples: The community recycling movement has gained tremendous momentum since municipal waste fees were introduced.

words.general_translation_vi: Vật lộn để giải quyết
meanings: To struggle hard to cope with or find solutions to a very challenging dilemma.
examples: Metropolitan councils must grapple with the dual challenges of escalating congestion and deteriorating air quality.

words.general_translation_vi: Lời chỉ trích gay gắt
meanings: Severe, unforgiving, and stern expressions of disapproval or condemnation.
examples: The government's sudden decision to curtail educational funding drew harsh criticism from academic unions.

words.general_translation_vi: Châm ngòi cho sự tranh cãi
meanings: To provoke strong public disagreement, outrage, or heated discourse.
examples: Plans to build a high-density commercial complex adjacent to a historic sanctuary ignited widespread controversy.

words.general_translation_vi: Rủi ro cố hữu
meanings: An unavoidable hazard that naturally belongs to the fundamental character of an activity.
examples: Extreme market volatility is an inherent risk that novice stock traders must carefully manage.

words.general_translation_vi: Bộ phận không thể tách rời
meanings: A crucial, indispensable component that is necessary to complete a greater system.
examples: Practical laboratory experimentation forms an integral part of modern undergraduate scientific training.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự cải thiện rõ rệt
meanings: A distinct, substantial, and easily observable enhancement in quality or capability.
examples: Pupils who attended remedial mathematics workshops demonstrated a marked improvement in standardized test scores.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu thập dữ liệu có thể kiểm chứng
meanings: To gather factual information that can be independently audited and proven accurate.
examples: Independent environmental auditors must obtain verifiable data before certifying a factory as carbon-neutral.

words.general_translation_vi: Thời khắc mang tính bước ngoặt
meanings: A critical turning point upon which future outcomes and developments decisively depend.
examples: The invention of the transistor was a pivotal moment that launched the modern semiconductor industry.

words.general_translation_vi: Chống biến đổi khí hậu
meanings: To take concerted, energetic measures to reduce global warming and its destructive impacts.
examples: Countries must cooperate globally to combat climate change by curbing industrial carbon emissions.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt giảm khí thải
meanings: To limit, restrain, or significantly decrease the discharge of pollutants into the atmosphere.
examples: Stricter vehicle inspection standards are intended to curb harmful exhaust emissions in central business districts.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm cạn kiệt tài nguyên thiên nhiên
meanings: To exhaust or severely reduce the available supply of vital ecological wealth.
examples: Overfishing and unregulated mining deplete natural resources essential for the sustenance of future generations.

words.general_translation_vi: Thảm họa sinh thái
meanings: A catastrophic event causing extensive and often permanent destruction to the living environment.
examples: An offshore oil spill of this magnitude represents an unprecedented ecological catastrophe for migratory seabirds.

words.general_translation_vi: Thân thiện với môi trường
meanings: Designed or functioning in a manner that causes minimal or no harm to the natural world.
examples: Urban commuter buses are progressively switching to environmentally friendly hydrogen fuel-cell engines.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự phụ thuộc vào nhiên liệu hóa thạch
meanings: Relying heavily on coal, oil, and gas for energy requirements.
examples: Ending our stubborn fossil fuel dependence is vital if we wish to avert catastrophic global warming.

words.general_translation_vi: Thiệt hại không thể đảo ngược
meanings: Harm or destruction so severe that it cannot be restored or repaired.
examples: Acidic ocean waters cause irreversible damage to fragile coral reefs and marine shellfish nurseries.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm thiểu các tác động
meanings: To make consequences less severe, painful, or damaging through proactive intervention.
examples: Planting extensive mangrove belts along shorelines helps mitigate the devastating effects of storm surges.

words.general_translation_vi: Các nguồn năng lượng tái tạo
meanings: Natural sources of energy, such as solar and wind, that replenish naturally and never run out.
examples: Subsidies have spurred private investment into renewable energy sources like offshore wind farms.

words.general_translation_vi: Phát triển bền vững
meanings: Economic growth that meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet theirs.
examples: Urban masterplans must integrate green transport networks to ensure balanced sustainable development.

words.general_translation_vi: Xử lý chất thải độc hại
meanings: The regulated process of eliminating or storing dangerous chemical by-products safely.
examples: Illegal toxic waste disposal into provincial rivers poses severe health risks to downstream farming towns.

words.general_translation_vi: Bảo tồn đa dạng sinh học
meanings: To protect the broad variety of plant and animal species living within their native ecosystems.
examples: Establishing strict wildlife sanctuaries is paramount if nations are to preserve biodiversity in tropical zones.

words.general_translation_vi: Bảo tồn môi trường sống của động vật hoang dã
meanings: To protect natural environments from encroachment and destruction.
examples: National conservation programs strive to conserve wildlife habitats threatened by expanding commercial agriculture.

words.general_translation_vi: Điều kiện khí hậu bất lợi
meanings: Severe or unfavorable weather patterns that disrupt ordinary agricultural or economic activities.
examples: Subsistence farmers in sub-Saharan regions increasingly battle against severe adverse climatic conditions.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm thiểu dấu chân carbon
meanings: Decreasing the total amount of greenhouse gases produced by an individual, company, or state.
examples: Corporate sustainability pledges place heavy emphasis on measurable carbon footprint reduction.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự biến chuyển khí hậu mạnh mẽ
meanings: Sudden, extreme changes in temperature, precipitation, and general meteorological trends.
examples: Paleontologists attribute several prehistoric mass extinctions to drastic climatic shifts caused by volcanic super-eruptions.

words.general_translation_vi: Hệ sinh thái mong manh
meanings: A delicate ecological community easily damaged or permanently uncoupled by outside disturbances.
examples: Arctic tundra represents a fragile ecosystem that responds with acute vulnerability to minor temperature increases.

words.general_translation_vi: Khí thải nhà kính
meanings: Gaseous substances that trap solar heat in the atmosphere, driving global thermal elevation.
examples: Industrialized economies have signed binding pacts to slash greenhouse gas emissions by forty percent.

words.general_translation_vi: Khai thác năng lượng tái tạo
meanings: To capture and utilize clean energy generated from natural resources.
examples: Coastal provinces possess immense potential to harness renewable power through tidal turbines and offshore wind.

words.general_translation_vi: Khủng hoảng môi trường cận kề
meanings: An approaching disaster concerning the natural biosphere that requires urgent prevention.
examples: Scientists issue stern warnings regarding the impending environmental crisis driven by unchecked plastic production.

words.general_translation_vi: Nồng độ chất gây ô nhiễm
meanings: The quantitative density of toxic compounds present in an atmospheric, soil, or aquatic sample.
examples: Air quality sensors registered an alarming rise in fine particulate pollutant concentration over the capital city.

words.general_translation_vi: Môi trường sống tự nhiên nguyên sơ
meanings: An untouched, unspoiled ecological territory unaffected by human interference or contamination.
examples: Ecotourists are urged to respect the pristine natural habitat of rare nesting sea turtles.

words.general_translation_vi: Ô nhiễm công nghiệp tràn lan
meanings: Uncontrolled and widespread discharge of chemical effluent and airborne contaminants by factories.
examples: Decades of rampant industrial pollution turned the municipal river into a biologically dead waterway.

words.general_translation_vi: Phục hồi đất đai thoái hóa
meanings: To restore infertile or damaged soil and ecosystems back to productive and ecological health.
examples: Afforestation initiatives successfully reclaim degraded land previously stripped by open-cast coal mining.

words.general_translation_vi: Chuyển đổi sang năng lượng xanh
meanings: The process of moving from carbon-heavy fossil fuels to sustainable, renewable energy sources.
examples: Governments must offer tax incentives to help small enterprises execute a smooth transition to green energy.

words.general_translation_vi: Đẩy nhanh tiến độ / tốc độ
meanings: To increase the velocity or speed at which a process or development unfolds.
examples: International research partnerships accelerate the pace of breakthrough vaccine development.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải quyết nguyên nhân gốc rễ
meanings: To tackle the foundational origin of a problem rather than just its outward symptoms.
examples: Social programs must address the root causes of systemic poverty rather than offering temporary financial palliatives.

words.general_translation_vi: Áp dụng phương pháp tiếp cận toàn diện
meanings: To handle a complex matter by addressing all interconnected components collectively.
examples: Modern healthcare clinics adopt a holistic approach that integrates physical medicine with psychological therapy.

words.general_translation_vi: Xóa đói giảm nghèo
meanings: To reduce the misery, deprivation, and financial hardship of disadvantaged populations.
examples: Targeted microcredit programs have demonstrated considerable efficacy in helping rural women alleviate poverty.

words.general_translation_vi: Phân bổ nguồn lực
meanings: To designate and distribute assets, finances, or personnel for a specific project.
examples: Treasury officials must prudently allocate resources to balance emergency healthcare demands with long-term infrastructure.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm gia tăng rủi ro
meanings: To heighten, intensify, or multiply the likelihood of negative consequences or danger.
examples: Dense urban populations and poor sanitary conditions amplify the risk of rapid infectious disease transmission.

words.general_translation_vi: Đạt được lợi thế cạnh tranh
meanings: To secure a superior market position or advantage compared to commercial rivals.
examples: Continuous investment in employee upskilling enables technology enterprises to attain a decisive competitive edge.

words.general_translation_vi: Phá vỡ vòng luẩn quẩn
meanings: To disrupt a recurring chain of negative events where one problem causes another.
examples: Free universal secondary education remains the most dependable tool to break the vicious cycle of poverty.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở rộng tầm nhìn, mở mang kiến thức
meanings: To expand a person's intellect, perspective, knowledge, and cultural understanding.
examples: International academic exchanges challenge students' preconceptions and broaden their cultural horizons.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy thay đổi xã hội
meanings: To trigger, inspire, or accelerate meaningful transformations across societal norms and policies.
examples: Independent investigative journalism has often catalyzed social change by exposing widespread governmental graft.

words.general_translation_vi: Dấu hiệu rõ ràng
meanings: An unmistakable sign, token, or symptom showing that something is happening.
examples: The steady decline in newspaper print subscriptions is a clear indication of the digital media migration.

words.general_translation_vi: Rèn luyện tư duy phản biện
meanings: To foster the mental capability to evaluate claims objectively and construct reasoned arguments.
examples: Modern tertiary curricula are deliberately structured to cultivate critical thinking rather than passive regurgitation.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt giảm chi tiêu
meanings: To reduce, restrict, or place limits on financial spending.
examples: During economic downturns, corporate leadership is frequently forced to curtail expenditure on marketing campaigns.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm kìm hãm tăng trưởng kinh tế
meanings: To slow down, restrain, or suppress the velocity of macroeconomic expansion.
examples: Protracted trade disputes and retaliatory tariffs threaten to dampen economic growth across export-dependent nations.

words.general_translation_vi: Trì hoãn phán xét
meanings: To withhold an official opinion or verdict until all pertinent facts are uncovered.
examples: Medical boards must defer judgment on novel experimental drugs until double-blind trial results are published.

words.general_translation_vi: Tìm thấy sự hài lòng từ
meanings: To obtain pleasure, contentment, or fulfillment from an activity or accomplishment.
examples: Dedicated social workers derive immense satisfaction from witnessing vulnerable families regain economic independence.

words.general_translation_vi: Răn đe hành vi phạm pháp
meanings: To discourage or prevent illegal activities through substantial sanctions or enforcement.
examples: Visible community policing and equitable judicial sentences help deter unlawful conduct in urban neighborhoods.

words.general_translation_vi: Xua tan những ngộ nhận phổ biến
meanings: To disprove and banish widely held falsehoods and erroneous beliefs.
examples: Public health officials organized neighborhood seminars to dispel widespread myths regarding vaccines.

words.general_translation_vi: Tác động không tương xứng
meanings: An effect that bears more heavily or unfairly on one group than on another.
examples: Food price inflation exerts a disproportionate impact on low-income households that spend most earnings on sustenance.

words.general_translation_vi: Động lực thúc đẩy
meanings: The primary influence, motivation, or energy compelling an action or development forward.
examples: Technological innovation has been the central driving force transforming global supply chain logistics.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự chênh lệch kinh tế
meanings: The significant and unfair inequality in wealth, income, and opportunity across social classes.
examples: Widening economic disparity between coastal cities and landlocked rural provinces requires targeted fiscal redistribution.

words.general_translation_vi: Gợi ra phản hồi mạnh mẽ
meanings: To evoke, provoke, or draw forth an intense reaction from observers or the public.
examples: The documentary about industrial livestock cruelty elicited a strong response from animal welfare advocates worldwide.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt tay thực hiện sáng kiến
meanings: To launch, start, or undertake a fresh systematic enterprise or strategic project.
examples: The regional authority decided to embark on an initiative aimed at reforesting abandoned timber hillsides.

words.general_translation_vi: Nâng cao thành tích học tập
meanings: To improve, elevate, or upgrade educational achievements and grades.
examples: Nutritious school breakfast programs directly enhance academic performance among undernourished primary pupils.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp thu các kỹ năng nền tảng
meanings: To learn and master essential core competencies necessary for future intellectual growth.
examples: Early childhood education allows children to acquire foundational skills in literacy and numeracy.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy sự xuất sắc trong học thuật
meanings: To encourage and nurture high standards of intellectual achievement and research quality.
examples: University honors colleges offer specialized seminars designed to foster academic excellence.

words.general_translation_vi: Đường cong học tập dốc (rất khó khăn ban đầu)
meanings: A situation where someone must learn a vast amount of difficult knowledge very rapidly.
examples: Novice software programmers face a steep learning curve when mastering low-level assembly languages.

words.general_translation_vi: Môi trường học tập thuận lợi
meanings: Surroundings and atmospheric conditions that actively support and inspire academic focus.
examples: Modern campus libraries combine quiet study cubicles with natural lighting to create a conducive learning environment.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm phong phú chương trình giảng dạy
meanings: To improve and expand educational content by introducing fresh, engaging subjects.
examples: Integrating global affairs and environmental ethics helps enrich the secondary school curriculum.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở rộng tầm hiểu biết tri thức
meanings: To expand the scope of one's thoughts, analytical comprehension, and philosophical viewpoints.
examples: Studying comparative world literature encourages students to broaden their intellectual horizons.

words.general_translation_vi: Học tập suốt đời
meanings: The ongoing, self-motivated pursuit of knowledge for personal or professional growth.
examples: Rapid technological innovation makes lifelong learning indispensable for maintaining workplace employability.

words.general_translation_vi: Nuôi dưỡng tài năng bẩm sinh
meanings: To encourage and cultivate inborn natural abilities through patient mentorship and training.
examples: Specialized music academies strive to nurture innate talent among gifted adolescent instrumentalists.

words.general_translation_vi: Đạt được chứng chỉ/bằng cấp được công nhận
meanings: To successfully complete certified courses yielding accredited degrees or vocational diplomas.
examples: Adult returners attend evening colleges to obtain recognized qualifications in accountancy and project management.

words.general_translation_vi: Đỗ đạt với kết quả xuất sắc
meanings: To succeed in an examination, test, or challenging trial with outstanding distinction.
examples: Having prepared meticulously for months, the candidate passed the foreign service diplomatic exam with flying colors.

words.general_translation_vi: Theo đuổi bậc học cao đẳng/đại học
meanings: To enroll in tertiary institutions such as universities to attain advanced academic degrees.
examples: Government bursaries empower talented rural youth to pursue higher education without incurring crippling student debt.

words.general_translation_vi: Phương pháp học vẹt
meanings: Techniques centered strictly on memorization through mechanical repetition rather than comprehension.
examples: Modern pedagogues discourage rote learning methods in favor of interactive, inquiry-based scientific exploration.

words.general_translation_vi: Thành tích học tập ở trường
meanings: A student's measurable accomplishments and grades in academic examinations and coursework.
examples: Adequate sleep and regular physical exercise strongly correlate with superior scholastic performance.

words.general_translation_vi: Chương trình đào tạo nghề
meanings: Practical instructional courses tailored to prepare learners directly for skilled technical trades.
examples: Municipalities invest in vocational training programs to equip unemployed school leavers with welding and electrical skills.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự phát triển toàn diện
meanings: Educational progress that nurtures cognitive, social, creative, and physical faculties harmoniously.
examples: Extracurricular athletics and debate societies contribute significantly to learners' well-rounded development.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu hẹp khoảng cách giáo dục
meanings: To eliminate inequalities in educational resource availability and instructional quality.
examples: Deploying high-speed satellite broadband to remote schools helps bridge persistent educational divides.

words.general_translation_vi: Phổ biến tri thức học thuật
meanings: To publish and share high-level academic research widely with the global scientific community.
examples: Open-access digital repositories enable universities to disseminate scholarly knowledge without subscription paywalls.

words.general_translation_vi: Nâng cao năng lực phân tích
meanings: To improve one's skill in examining complex data and identifying logical deductions.
examples: Undergraduate research dissertations challenge students and significantly enhance their analytical capabilities.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo điều kiện cho việc học tập hợp tác
meanings: To enable and encourage group discussions and cooperative problem-solving among students.
examples: Interactive digital whiteboards facilitate collaborative learning by allowing group members to edit mindmaps simultaneously.

words.general_translation_vi: Khơi dậy niềm đam mê tò mò học hỏi
meanings: To spark a deep, eager desire in students to explore and comprehend unfamiliar ideas.
examples: Hands-on science museum exhibits are brilliantly engineered to ignite intellectual curiosity in young visitors.

words.general_translation_vi: Thấm nhuần các nguyên tắc đạo đức
meanings: To firmly implant ethical standards, integrity, and social values into someone's character.
examples: Primary school teachers strive to instill moral principles such as honesty, empathy, and respect for diversity.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm chủ những môn học phức tạp
meanings: To achieve complete understanding, skill, and proficiency in challenging academic disciplines.
examples: Dedicated study habits enable determined undergraduates to master complex subjects like quantum mechanics.

words.general_translation_vi: Khuyến khích tư duy suy ngẫm sâu sắc
meanings: To urge students to evaluate assumptions and personal experiences with thoughtful rigor.
examples: Philosophy tutorials promote critical reflection regarding ethical responsibilities in an automated society.

words.general_translation_vi: Củng cố sự hiểu biết về mặt khái niệm
meanings: To deepen and solidify a student's grasp of core theoretical ideas rather than superficial rules.
examples: Practical laboratory demonstrations reinforce conceptual understanding of thermodynamic principles.

words.general_translation_vi: Đánh giá học thuật theo thang chuẩn hóa
meanings: Formal testing administered under uniform conditions to measure pupils' comparative proficiency.
examples: Reliance on standardized academic assessment can inadvertently prompt teachers to teach strictly to the exam.

words.general_translation_vi: Kích thích sự phát triển trí tuệ
meanings: To activate and accelerate mental expansion, analytical thinking, and knowledge depth.
examples: Engaging in rigorous academic debates serves to stimulate intellectual growth across university faculties.

words.general_translation_vi: Trợ cấp cho giáo dục đại học
meanings: To provide state financial grants lowering the tuition cost of university study for citizens.
examples: Progressive nations subsidize higher education to democratize access to advanced professional careers.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải phóng tiềm năng sáng tạo
meanings: To release and maximize latent imaginative and innovative abilities in individuals.
examples: Flexible, arts-integrated classroom environments unlock creative potential in pupils who struggle with traditional exams.

words.general_translation_vi: Đem lại kết quả học tập tích cực
meanings: To produce significant long-term benefits and accomplishments in educational metrics.
examples: Investing in high-quality early childhood tutoring continues to yield rich academic dividends throughout secondary school.

words.general_translation_vi: Đạt được chuyên môn sâu rộng
meanings: To gain comprehensive, authoritative proficiency in a specialized academic or technical domain.
examples: Doctoral candidates spend years conducting intensive research to acquire deep expertise in genetic epidemiology.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải quyết các khó khăn trong học tập
meanings: To diagnose and provide remedial assistance for specific educational impediments like dyslexia.
examples: Special educational needs coordinators help teachers address learning difficulties with customized teaching aids.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở rộng các phương pháp sư phạm
meanings: To diversify instructional techniques, incorporating multimedia, experiential, and flipped classroom models.
examples: Teacher training colleges encourage educators to broaden pedagogical approaches to engage diverse student cohorts.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy việc học tập tự chủ
meanings: To develop students' ability to direct, pace, and manage their own educational progress independently.
examples: Digital resource libraries empower secondary pupils by fostering autonomous learning habits outside the classroom.

words.general_translation_vi: Nuôi dưỡng hoài bão học thuật
meanings: To encourage and support learners' aspirations to pursue advanced academic research and discovery.
examples: Dedicated faculty mentorship is instrumental in nurturing scholarly ambitions among undergraduate researchers.

words.general_translation_vi: Cải tổ các chương trình giảng dạy lỗi thời
meanings: To comprehensively revise educational courses to align with contemporary industrial requirements.
examples: The education ministry must overhaul outdated curricula to incorporate artificial intelligence and data science.

words.general_translation_vi: Đẩy nhanh quá trình chuyển đổi số
meanings: To speed up the systematic integration of digital technology into all areas of business and governance.
examples: The pandemic compelled traditional financial institutions to accelerate digital transformation across retail banking.

words.general_translation_vi: Ra quyết định dựa trên thuật toán
meanings: Using automated computational models and neural networks to guide operational or strategic choices.
examples: In modern logistics, algorithm-driven decision making optimizes delivery routes and minimizes vehicular fuel consumption.

words.general_translation_vi: Tự động hóa các thao tác lặp đi lặp lại
meanings: To replace manual, repetitive business tasks with computer software and mechanical robotics.
examples: Manufacturing plants automate routine operations on assembly lines to diminish defect rates and worker fatigue.

words.general_translation_vi: Đột phá đổi mới công nghệ
meanings: A major, revolutionary advancement in science and engineering that fundamentally transforms capabilities.
examples: Solid-state battery chemistry represents a breakthrough technological innovation that will transform electric mobility.

words.general_translation_vi: Lỗ hổng an ninh mạng
meanings: A flaw or weakness in software code that can be exploited by malicious actors to compromise systems.
examples: Unpatched legacy operating systems present a critical cybersecurity vulnerability in public hospital infrastructure.

words.general_translation_vi: Thông tin chi tiết đúc kết từ dữ liệu
meanings: Actionable knowledge and patterns derived from the systematic statistical analysis of extensive data sets.
examples: Marketing executives rely on data-driven insights to tailor promotional campaigns to distinct consumer demographics.

words.general_translation_vi: Kỹ năng hiểu biết công nghệ số
meanings: The capability to evaluate, utilize, and communicate information using digital platforms effectively.
examples: Workforce development programs prioritize teaching digital literacy skills to older workers displaced by automation.

words.general_translation_vi: Phá vỡ / đảo lộn các ngành công nghiệp truyền thống
meanings: To radically alter established commercial markets through innovative digital business models.
examples: Ride-hailing smartphone applications swiftly disrupted traditional taxi industries across global metropolises.

words.general_translation_vi: Nâng cao năng suất hoạt động
meanings: To increase the efficiency, output, and speed of business processes while minimizing waste.
examples: Implementing enterprise resource software helps manufacturing firms enhance operational productivity significantly.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự phát triển công nghệ theo cấp số nhân
meanings: Extremely rapid and compounding acceleration in technological power and computational capacity.
examples: The past two decades have witnessed exponential technological growth in microchip density and wireless networking.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo điều kiện giao tiếp liền mạch
meanings: To enable smooth, uninterrupted, and effortless exchange of data and messages across platforms.
examples: Cloud collaboration platforms facilitate seamless communication between dispersed multinational engineering teams.

words.general_translation_vi: Khai thác trí tuệ nhân tạo
meanings: To apply and utilize machine learning and neural algorithms to solve intricate commercial or scientific tasks.
examples: Radiologists harness artificial intelligence to detect microscopic pulmonary tumors on diagnostic CT scans.

words.general_translation_vi: Tích hợp một cách liền mạch
meanings: To combine or merge smoothly with existing systems without creating friction or operational glitches.
examples: The new payment gateway integrates seamlessly with our existing e-commerce storefront.

words.general_translation_vi: Công nghệ lỗi thời
meanings: Equipment, machinery, or software that is no longer useful or produced because newer alternatives exist.
examples: Facsimile machines and dial-up modems represent obsolete technology largely discarded by contemporary enterprises.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiên phong nghiên cứu đột phá
meanings: To lead the exploration of completely new scientific concepts that dramatically advance human knowledge.
examples: University biochemistry institutes pioneer groundbreaking research into targeted messenger RNA vaccines.

words.general_translation_vi: Gia tăng / bùng nổ nhanh chóng
meanings: To multiply, reproduce, or spread with exceptional velocity and widespread prevalence.
examples: Connected Internet-of-Things devices continue to proliferate rapidly across smart municipal infrastructure.

words.general_translation_vi: Cách mạng hóa ngành công nghiệp
meanings: To completely change and modernize how a commercial sector operates through transformative innovations.
examples: The arrival of low-cost commercial space flight has revolutionized the global telecommunications satellite industry.

words.general_translation_vi: Bảo vệ quyền riêng tư số
meanings: To protect personal computerized data and electronic communication records from unauthorized monitoring.
examples: Comprehensive data protection regulations are designed to safeguard digital privacy against predatory analytics firms.

words.general_translation_vi: Khơi mào cuộc cách mạng công nghệ
meanings: To trigger a rapid era of sweeping technological transformation that remakes industrial systems.
examples: The commercial development of high-capacity lithium batteries sparked a technological revolution in personal mobility.

words.general_translation_vi: Cơ sở hạ tầng tối tân
meanings: The most modern, advanced, and sophisticated physical and digital facilities available.
examples: Singapore has attracted global pharmaceutical giants by constructing state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure.

words.general_translation_vi: Biến đổi mô hình kinh doanh
meanings: To fundamentally alter how companies create, deliver, and capture commercial value in an industry.
examples: Subscription streaming services transformed business models across music distribution and theatrical film release.

words.general_translation_vi: Kết nối internet phổ biến ở khắp mọi nơi
meanings: The widespread and constant presence of high-speed wireless web access throughout society.
examples: Ubiquitous internet connectivity enables white-collar staff to execute complex corporate duties from any locale.

words.general_translation_vi: Năng lực tính toán chưa từng có
meanings: Processing speed and capacity greater than anything achieved in previous computational history.
examples: Modern quantum processors offer unprecedented computational power capable of simulating complex molecular folding.

words.general_translation_vi: Giao diện thân thiện với người dùng
meanings: A software layout that is intuitive, simple to navigate, and easy for non-specialists to operate.
examples: The mobile banking application features an exceptionally user-friendly interface designed for senior citizens.

words.general_translation_vi: Mô phỏng thực tế ảo
meanings: A computer-generated immersive three-dimensional environment that mimics realistic scenarios for training.
examples: Aviation flight schools utilize virtual reality simulation to train trainee pilots in emergency engine-out maneuvers.

words.general_translation_vi: Gia tăng năng lực con người
meanings: To expand and enhance mental or sensory faculties using advanced technical tools.
examples: Exoskeletons and robotic surgical tools augment human capabilities in delicate microscopic procedures.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiềm chế định kiến thuật toán
meanings: To prevent automated machine-learning models from discriminating against specific social cohorts.
examples: Auditing training data sets is essential to curb algorithmic bias in automated mortgage approval software.

words.general_translation_vi: Bình dân hóa quyền tiếp cận công nghệ
meanings: To make powerful digital equipment and software affordable and accessible to ordinary citizens.
examples: Open-source software projects democratize technology access by providing free computational tools worldwide.

words.general_translation_vi: Triển khai các hệ thống tự hành
meanings: To put into active operational service vehicles and robots that function without human pilots.
examples: Port terminals deploy autonomous systems, including self-guided container straddle carriers, to speed unloading.

words.general_translation_vi: Nâng cao khả năng phục hồi an ninh mạng
meanings: To strengthen an organization's capacity to prepare for, withstand, and rapidly recover from digital attacks.
examples: Routine penetration testing and redundant offline backups enhance cyber resilience across corporate networks.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm thiểu các mối đe dọa kỹ thuật số
meanings: To diminish the danger and impact of computer viruses, phishing, and ransomware strikes.
examples: Continuous behavioral monitoring on cloud servers helps financial enterprises mitigate digital threats effectively.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở đường cho tự động hóa
meanings: To create the technological and operational conditions that allow manual tasks to become automated.
examples: Standardizing digital assembly protocols paved the path to widespread robotic automation in automobile manufacturing.

words.general_translation_vi: Quản lý / điều tiết trí tuệ nhân tạo
meanings: To establish enforceable legal guardrails and safety standards governing machine-learning systems.
examples: Parliamentary committees convened to draft legislation intended to regulate artificial intelligence deployment responsibly.

words.general_translation_vi: Hợp lý hóa quy trình làm việc số
meanings: To eliminate redundant steps and optimize operational procedures using integrated computer software.
examples: Adopting unified customer relationship management software helped the consultancy streamline digital workflows.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở ra một kỷ nguyên công nghệ mới
meanings: To introduce or mark the start of a transformative period dominated by new scientific breakthroughs.
examples: The successful commercialization of graphene semiconductors is expected to usher in a revolutionary technological era.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm tải ùn tắc đô thị
meanings: To lessen traffic jams and overcrowding on metropolitan transportation networks.
examples: Constructing separated subterranean metro routes serves to alleviate urban congestion during peak commuter hours.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu hẹp khoảng cách giữa các thế hệ
meanings: To foster mutual understanding and communication between elderly and youthful social demographics.
examples: Community storytelling workshops bring teenagers and retirees together to bridge the generational divide.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy phát triển cộng đồng
meanings: To stimulate rapid social and economic improvements in local civic neighborhoods.
examples: Micro-grants distributed to local craft cooperatives effectively catalyze community development in rural towns.

words.general_translation_vi: Tôn vinh sự đa dạng văn hóa
meanings: To acknowledge, respect, and enthusiastically honor the diverse traditions and heritages in a society.
examples: The annual metropolitan arts carnival brings distinct ethnic groups together to celebrate cultural diversity.

words.general_translation_vi: Chống lại sự cô lập xã hội
meanings: To prevent and reduce the profound loneliness and detachment experienced by vulnerable citizens.
examples: Senior community centers offer chess clubs and gardening activities to combat social isolation among the elderly.

words.general_translation_vi: Đối đầu với bất công mang tính hệ thống
meanings: To challenge and reform entrenched institutional biases and structural inequities in society.
examples: Civil rights attorneys work tirelessly to confront systemic injustice within regional juvenile sentencing guidelines.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiềm chế tội phạm vị thành niên
meanings: To reduce and deter criminal acts and antisocial behavior perpetrated by underage youths.
examples: After-school athletic leagues and creative workshops help curb juvenile delinquency in distressed urban estates.

words.general_translation_vi: Xóa bỏ rào cản xã hội
meanings: To eliminate prejudiced customs, prejudices, and obstacles that prevent equality of opportunity.
examples: Inclusive workplace hiring guidelines dismantle social barriers that historically excluded disabled applicants.

words.general_translation_vi: Đón nhận chủ nghĩa đa văn hóa
meanings: To actively welcome, respect, and integrate diverse ethnic communities into the national fabric.
examples: Modern progressive democracies embrace multiculturalism as a source of dynamic innovation and cultural richness.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm xói mòn cấu trúc xã hội
meanings: To gradually weaken, damage, or disintegrate community trust, solidarity, and civic institutions.
examples: Rampant political polarization and economic inequality threaten to erode the social fabric of the republic.

words.general_translation_vi: Gánh chịu gánh nặng tài chính
meanings: To endure the heavy monetary costs, debts, or expenses of a project or policy.
examples: Underfunded municipal councils can no longer bear the financial burdens of maintaining decaying regional bridge networks.

words.general_translation_vi: Kích cầu nội địa
meanings: To stimulate household consumer spending and business purchasing within national borders.
examples: Central banks cut lending interest rates to boost domestic demand during periods of export contraction.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt giảm chi phí vận hành
meanings: To reduce recurring administrative and manufacturing running costs within an organization.
examples: Airlines were forced to curtail operational expenditure by mothballing older, fuel-inefficient twin-engine aircraft.

words.general_translation_vi: Đa dạng hóa các nguồn doanh thu
meanings: To expand income sources across distinct products, services, or markets to lessen fiscal vulnerability.
examples: Media publishers must diversify revenue streams into subscriber newsletters, podcasting, and corporate events.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự trì trệ kinh tế
meanings: A prolonged period of little or no macroeconomic growth characterized by stagnant wages.
examples: Uncontrolled sovereign debt coupled with declining labor productivity plunged the nation into a decade of economic stagnation.

words.general_translation_vi: Các thị trường mới nổi
meanings: Economies of developing nations that are experiencing rapid industrialization and market expansion.
examples: Multinational investment funds channel capital toward emerging markets in Southeast Asia and Latin America.

words.general_translation_vi: Gây áp lực tài chính
meanings: To apply monetary distress, demanding requirements, or leverage on an individual or entity.
examples: Rising commercial mortgage rates exert acute financial pressure on small independent retail businesses.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy tinh thần khởi nghiệp
meanings: To cultivate an economic climate that supports the founding, risk-taking, and growth of startups.
examples: Special economic incubators provide tax holidays and technical mentoring to foster vibrant technology entrepreneurship.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo ra doanh thu bền vững
meanings: To produce reliable, long-term commercial income without depleting capital or exploiting assets.
examples: Ecotourism cooperatives generate sustainable revenue for indigenous Amazonian settlements while protecting the primary rainforest.

words.general_translation_vi: Gánh chịu các khoản lỗ đáng kể
meanings: To experience heavy financial deficits or damage resulting from investments or disasters.
examples: Commercial real estate trusts incurred substantial losses as remote working permanently diminished office leasing demand.

words.general_translation_vi: Áp lực lạm phát
meanings: Economic factors such as surging energy prices and wage increases that drive up consumer price indexes.
examples: Central monetary authorities raised benchmark lending rates to cool intensifying domestic inflationary pressures.

words.general_translation_vi: Cơ hội đầu tư sinh lời béo bở
meanings: A venture, asset, or business holding strong potential to generate substantial financial profits.
examples: Developing offshore wind farms along breezy coastal gulfs represents a highly lucrative investment opportunity.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự biến động của thị trường
meanings: The erratic and unpredictable rises and falls in commodity, bond, or stock equity prices.
examples: Pension funds protect their capital against turbulent market fluctuations by diversifying across international asset classes.

words.general_translation_vi: Tối ưu hóa hiệu quả hoạt động
meanings: To redesign organizational workflows to achieve maximum productive output with minimum wasted expenditure.
examples: Automating logistics dispatch centers enabled the shipping company to optimize operational efficiency and slash transit times.

words.general_translation_vi: Vượt trội hơn các đối thủ cạnh tranh chính
meanings: To achieve superior sales, profit margins, or technical milestones compared to competitors.
examples: By patenting superior solid-state battery cells, the electric vehicle maker managed to outperform key rivals.

words.general_translation_vi: Rơi vào suy thoái kinh tế
meanings: To enter suddenly and deeply into a phase of widespread macroeconomic contraction and rising joblessness.
examples: The sudden international oil embargo caused import-reliant manufacturing states to plunge into a severe recession.

words.general_translation_vi: Kích hoạt / đẩy nhanh cuộc khủng hoảng tài chính
meanings: To cause a sudden and uncontrolled collapse of banking systems, credit markets, or corporate liquidity.
examples: Reckless subprime mortgage lending precipitated a catastrophic global financial crisis in the late 2000s.

words.general_translation_vi: Gặt hái các lợi ích kinh tế
meanings: To collect, enjoy, and benefit from positive monetary and commercial outcomes resulting from policies.
examples: Nations that invested early in universal broadband infrastructure are now reaping massive economic benefits.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiềm chế chi phí leo thang
meanings: To limit and keep under control expenses that are compounding and escalating uncontrollably.
examples: Hospital administrators adopted generic pharmaceutical substitutions to restrain spiraling medical supply costs.

words.general_translation_vi: Tăng trưởng kinh tế mạnh mẽ
meanings: Strong, healthy, and resilient macroeconomic expansion that generates substantial employment.
examples: Favorable export agreements and domestic infrastructure spending stimulated a prolonged period of robust economic growth.

words.general_translation_vi: Bảo đảm nguồn vốn đầu tư
meanings: To successfully acquire essential financing from venture capitalists, banks, or sovereign grants.
examples: Biotechnology research spin-offs must secure capital funding before commencing Phase II human clinical trials.

words.general_translation_vi: Tỷ lệ lạm phát tăng vọt
meanings: Rapid, steep, and damaging price increases across basic consumer goods and services.
examples: Soaring inflation rates have severely eroded the real purchasing power of minimum-wage industrial workers.

words.general_translation_vi: Kích thích hoạt động thương mại
meanings: To encourage greater buying, selling, investing, and trading across an economic zone.
examples: Pedestrianizing downtown historic corridors helped stimulate vibrant commercial activity for local cafes and boutiques.

words.general_translation_vi: Trợ cấp cho các ngành công nghiệp non trẻ
meanings: To provide financial backing to newly established domestic commercial sectors to help them survive global competition.
examples: Developing nations often subsidize fledgling industries, such as commercial aerospace and semiconductor fabrication.

words.general_translation_vi: Điều kiện thị trường biến động dữ dội
meanings: Commercial environments where asset valuations and customer demands fluctuate rapidly and unpredictably.
examples: Commodity exporters must exercise disciplined currency hedging to survive persistently volatile market conditions.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngăn chặn đầu cơ tiền tệ
meanings: To impose financial rules that deter destabilizing, short-term betting on exchange rates.
examples: The central treasury introduced transaction levies to curb destabilizing currency speculation during the debt crisis.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu hút / thúc đẩy đầu tư trực tiếp nước ngoài
meanings: To create a welcoming legal and fiscal environment that encourages overseas corporations to build domestic facilities.
examples: Transparent corporate taxation codes and streamlined commercial courts help foster foreign direct investment.

words.general_translation_vi: Gánh chịu các nghĩa vụ nợ nần
meanings: To become legally responsible for repaying substantial borrowed monetary sums and interest.
examples: Developing states must avoid incurring unsustainable debt obligations when financing massive maritime ports.

words.general_translation_vi: Đánh thuế quan lên
meanings: To officially impose custom duties or taxes on imported foreign goods and commodities.
examples: The administration decided to levy tariffs on imported steel to shield domestic blast-furnace operations from price undercutting.

words.general_translation_vi: Đàm phán các hiệp định thương mại
meanings: To hold formal multilateral discussions establishing international terms for import and export tariffs.
examples: Senior diplomats spent five years negotiating comprehensive trade agreements covering cross-border digital services.

words.general_translation_vi: Đề cao kỷ luật tài khóa
meanings: To enforce strict limits on government budget deficits, preventing excessive sovereign borrowing.
examples: The central bank governor praised the national budget for promoting rigorous fiscal discipline and debt reduction.

words.general_translation_vi: Dập tắt nỗi lo ngại lạm phát
meanings: To calm market anxieties regarding potential compounding price increases through decisive monetary signaling.
examples: The central bank surprised international markets by raising interest rates early, successfully quelling inflationary fears.

words.general_translation_vi: Tăng cường tính thanh khoản thị trường
meanings: To ensure ample cash and credit flow through interbank markets so that assets can be traded smoothly.
examples: Emergency central bank bond purchasing programs stepped in to reinforce market liquidity during the liquidity freeze.

words.general_translation_vi: Ổn định giá cả hàng hóa
meanings: To prevent drastic, erratic price swings in vital raw materials like petroleum, grain, and metals.
examples: Establishing regional grain reserves helps stabilize commodity prices during localized agricultural droughts.

words.general_translation_vi: Chống chịu các cú sốc kinh tế
meanings: To remain solvent, resilient, and functioning during sudden international market downturns or trade disruptions.
examples: Economies with diverse manufacturing sectors are best equipped to withstand sudden external economic shocks.

words.general_translation_vi: Chống lại các bệnh truyền nhiễm
meanings: To undertake coordinated medical measures preventing the spread of transmissible viral and bacterial illnesses.
examples: Global health organizations deploy mass inoculation networks to combat infectious diseases in equatorial regions.

words.general_translation_vi: Sức khỏe thể chất suy giảm
meanings: Worsening physiological well-being, stamina, and bodily functioning over time.
examples: Prolonged sedentary employment without athletic exercise contributes directly to deteriorating physical health.

words.general_translation_vi: Tác động bất lợi cho sức khỏe
meanings: Damaging, injurious, or harmful consequences to the human body resulting from exposure or habits.
examples: Medical researchers highlighted the detrimental health effects of consuming heavily processed meats on colorectal function.

words.general_translation_vi: Xóa bỏ các bệnh có thể phòng ngừa
meanings: To eliminate completely diseases that can be stopped through simple hygiene, clean water, or vaccinations.
examples: Universal childhood immunization campaigns aim to eradicate preventable illnesses like measles and polio worldwide.

words.general_translation_vi: Lựa chọn lối sống lành mạnh
meanings: Decisions regarding nutrition, regular exercise, sleep, and stress management that preserve wellbeing.
examples: Primary schools should inspire children to make healthy lifestyle choices regarding daily fruit and vegetable intake.

words.general_translation_vi: Tổn thương tâm lý nặng nề
meanings: The substantial emotional suffering, distress, and trauma caused by extreme hardship or stress.
examples: Enduring prolonged lockdowns and social isolation took a heavy psychological toll on single-person households.

words.general_translation_vi: Cải thiện kết quả sức khỏe
meanings: To achieve measurable clinical gains in patient recovery rates, longevity, and disease management.
examples: Early cancer screening initiatives markedly improve health outcomes by detecting malignancies before metastasis.

words.general_translation_vi: Các bệnh mãn tính không thể chữa khỏi
meanings: Long-lasting physical disorders that can be managed with therapeutic drugs but cannot be permanently eradicated.
examples: Patients suffering from incurable chronic conditions like type 1 diabetes rely on daily subcutaneous insulin administration.

words.general_translation_vi: Duy trì sự cân bằng tâm lý
meanings: To keep one's emotional balance, sanity, and calm state of mind amid acute external pressures.
examples: Practicing mindfulness meditation assists healthcare professionals in maintaining mental equilibrium during hospital crises.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm thiểu các rủi ro sức khỏe
meanings: To reduce the probability or severity of illness, injury, or biological harm through preventive habits.
examples: Wearing protective respiratory masks helps industrial painters mitigate health risks associated with aerosolized solvents.

words.general_translation_vi: Sức khỏe thể chất và tinh thần
meanings: The holistic state of bodily vigor, emotional happiness, and psychological flourishing.
examples: Corporate wellness programs place equal emphasis on the physical and mental wellbeing of their personnel.

words.general_translation_vi: Các biện pháp y tế phòng ngừa
meanings: Proactive interventions, such as routine screenings and immunizations, designed to forestall illnesses.
examples: Investing national revenue in preventive healthcare measures reduces the subsequent strain on emergency hospital wards.

words.general_translation_vi: Kéo dài tuổi thọ
meanings: To increase the average statistical length of time that individuals are projected to survive.
examples: Clean running water, antibiotic discoveries, and refrigeration have done more to prolong life expectancy than complex surgery.

words.general_translation_vi: Nỗi đau buồn / căng thẳng tâm lý
meanings: Unpleasant emotional feelings of severe anxiety, depression, cognitive strain, or mental agony.
examples: Unemployment and sudden eviction generate immense psychological distress for low-income single parents.

words.general_translation_vi: Thói quen sinh hoạt thụ động, ít vận động
meanings: Lifestyles characterized by excessive seated screen time and an acute absence of physical exertion.
examples: Epidemiologists warn that sedentary daily habits contribute substantially to the modern epidemic of type 2 diabetes.

words.general_translation_vi: Tập luyện thể chất cường độ cao
meanings: Vigorous, demanding bodily exertion that pushes cardiovascular and muscular endurance.
examples: Cardiologists advise middle-aged adults to consult physicians before commencing unaccustomed strenuous physical exercise.

words.general_translation_vi: Khuất phục / qua đời vì bệnh tật
meanings: To become unable to resist or survive the progressive onslaught of a serious medical condition.
examples: Before modern antibiotics were formulated, millions would succumb to illness from minor bacterial wound infections.

words.general_translation_vi: Dễ bị nhiễm trùng
meanings: Having a weakened immune defense that makes one easily vulnerable to bacterial and viral pathogens.
examples: Immunocompromised transplant patients remain acutely susceptible to infections and require sterile hospital environments.

words.general_translation_vi: Thói quen ăn uống không lành mạnh
meanings: Nutritional patterns dominated by hyper-processed foods, saturated fats, refined sugars, and low fiber.
examples: The widespread proliferation of cheap fast food has entrenched unhealthy dietary habits among urban adolescents.

words.general_translation_vi: Các chỉ số sức khỏe quan trọng
meanings: Crucial physiological metrics, such as blood pressure, heart rate, and oxygen saturation, indicating physical state.
examples: Paramedics immediately monitor vital health indicators when responding to emergency vehicular collisions.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm dịu cơn đau mãn tính
meanings: To diminish, ease, or provide therapeutic relief from persistent, debilitating bodily discomfort.
examples: Specialized physiotherapy routines assist elderly patients in alleviating chronic pain caused by osteoarthritis.

words.general_translation_vi: Đối phó với căng thẳng
meanings: To manage and deal successfully with difficult emotional strains and professional pressures.
examples: Developing regular aerobic exercise habits provides students with constructive ways to cope with academic stress.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngăn chặn sự lây lan của dịch bệnh
meanings: To take decisive quarantine, sanitation, and medical containment steps to halt outbreaks.
examples: Strict border health screenings and rapid contact tracing helped regional authorities curb the spread of epidemics.

words.general_translation_vi: Chẩn đoán bệnh sớm
meanings: To identify disorders at an initial, treatable stage before severe pathology develops.
examples: Automated blood biomarker analysis enables clinicians to diagnose serious medical conditions early.

words.general_translation_vi: Phục hồi chức năng cho bệnh nhân bị chấn thương
meanings: To guide hurt individuals through therapeutic training so they regain physical mobility and self-sufficiency.
examples: Specialized trauma units work around the clock to rehabilitate injured patients recovering from motor vehicle crashes.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt giảm lượng tiêu thụ rượu bia
meanings: To decrease the amount of alcoholic drinks ingested to prevent liver damage and domestic violence.
examples: Public health warnings and minimum unit pricing have encouraged youth to curtail alcohol consumption significantly.

words.general_translation_vi: Nuôi dưỡng sự kiên cường về mặt cảm xúc
meanings: To cultivate the internal psychological ability to withstand, process, and recover from trauma and adversity.
examples: Compassionate parental support is paramount in fostering emotional resilience during turbulent adolescent years.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy giáo dục về dinh dưỡng
meanings: To teach communities about balanced caloric intake, micronutrients, and cooking wholesome meals.
examples: Community clinics promote nutritional education to curb escalating rates of childhood diabetes and obesity.

words.general_translation_vi: Khắc phục tình trạng thiếu hụt dinh dưỡng
meanings: To resolve inadequate vitamin and mineral levels through enriched foods or dietary supplementation.
examples: Food fortification programs in developing provinces help remedy iron and iodine deficiencies in nursing mothers.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm vơi đi nỗi đau tâm lý
meanings: To provide compassionate clinical therapy that eases intense internal grief and trauma.
examples: Trauma counseling teams were deployed to the disaster zone to alleviate psychological suffering among displaced survivors.

words.general_translation_vi: Tuân thủ pháp luật
meanings: To obey, respect, and conform to the established statutory regulations of a nation.
examples: Every citizen, regardless of commercial wealth or political influence, is expected to abide by the law.

words.general_translation_vi: Sửa đổi hiến pháp
meanings: To formally alter or update the supreme foundational legal charter of a state through legislative voting.
examples: A two-thirds parliamentary majority was required to amend the constitution and guarantee universal data privacy.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngăn chặn tham nhũng trong chính quyền
meanings: To institute strict transparency rules and prosecutions that prevent officials from abusing public power.
examples: Independent anti-graft commissions were empowered by statute to curb governmental corruption in public procurement.

words.general_translation_vi: Thực thi các quy định nghiêm ngặt
meanings: To ensure that stringent administrative standards are vigorously adhered to by businesses.
examples: Maritime authorities enforce strict regulations governing oil tanker hull double-lining to avert spills.

words.general_translation_vi: Thiết lập quan hệ ngoại giao
meanings: To establish formal, cooperative political and consular relations between sovereign states.
examples: The newly independent republic sought to forge amicable diplomatic ties with all bordering nations.

words.general_translation_vi: Thực hiện các cải cách theo luật định
meanings: To put into practice legally enacted structural changes to national administrative systems.
examples: The prime minister pledged to implement statutory reforms eliminating bureaucratic delays in judicial proceedings.

words.general_translation_vi: Duy trì sự ổn định địa chính trị
meanings: To preserve peace, balance of power, and mutual defense cooperation across international regions.
examples: Multilateral diplomatic treaties play a vital role in maintaining geopolitical stability across the Pacific basin.

words.general_translation_vi: Hòa giải các xung đột quốc tế
meanings: To act as an impartial third-party negotiator helping warring nations achieve a peaceful settlement.
examples: Neutral Scandinavian nations frequently offer neutral territory to mediate complex international conflicts.

words.general_translation_vi: Ban hành luật pháp mới
meanings: To officially proclaim, enact, and bring into force fresh parliamentary statutes.
examples: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to promulgate new legislation criminalizing environmental ecocide.

words.general_translation_vi: Phê chuẩn các điều ước quốc tế
meanings: To formally approve and give formal legal sanction to international pacts by sovereign vote.
examples: Member nations gathered at the assembly to ratify international treaties eliminating biological weaponry.

words.general_translation_vi: Bãi bỏ các đạo luật lỗi thời
meanings: To officially revoke and annul antiquated legislative acts that no longer fit modern society.
examples: Law reform commissions periodically review the penal code to repeal obsolete statutes dating back to the colonial era.

words.general_translation_vi: Duy trì pháp quyền
meanings: To protect the principle that all members of society are equally subject to publicly disclosed laws.
examples: An independent and uncorrupted judiciary is the bedrock required to uphold the rule of law in a democracy.

words.general_translation_vi: Vi phạm luật pháp quốc tế
meanings: To commit acts that breach formal treaties, Geneva conventions, or sovereign border agreements.
examples: Unprovoked military incursions across sovereign national borders flagrantly violate international law.

words.general_translation_vi: Đòi hỏi sự can thiệp của tư pháp
meanings: To justify or necessitate formal legal action, injunctions, or review by a court of law.
examples: Systematic anti-competitive collusion between telecommunications giants warrants immediate judicial intervention.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhượng bộ trước áp lực dư luận
meanings: To concede, change policy, or give up an unpopular course of action due to widespread protests.
examples: The municipal council was forced to yield to public pressure and abandon plans to commercialize the public park.

words.general_translation_vi: Phân bổ nguồn tài trợ đáng kể
meanings: To designate large sums of public or private money toward an essential societal endeavor.
examples: The ministry will allocate substantial funding toward early cancer detection clinics in rural districts.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy tình đoàn kết xã hội
meanings: To build mutual empathy, shared responsibility, and communal support across social divisions.
examples: Neighborhood volunteering networks foster social solidarity among long-term residents and newly arrived immigrants.

words.general_translation_vi: Hòa giải các lợi ích xung đột
meanings: To find a balanced, mutually agreeable compromise between opposing parties or stakeholder groups.
examples: Environmental mediators worked diligently to reconcile conflicting interests between local fisheries and offshore oil developers.

words.general_translation_vi: Tàn phá nặng nề
meanings: To cause immense, catastrophic damage, destruction, or chaos to a system or environment.
examples: Invasive insect pests can wreak havoc on indigenous forestry and commercial fruit orchards.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngăn chặn làn sóng tiêu cực
meanings: To halt, arrest, or reverse a mounting negative trend or damaging development.
examples: Emergency fiscal subsidies helped stem the tide of small enterprise bankruptcies during the acute economic downturn.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo sân chơi bình đẳng
meanings: To ensure that all competitors or individuals have equal opportunities and identical rules.
examples: Universal access to digital textbooks is essential to level the playing field for economically disadvantaged students.

words.general_translation_vi: Ứng phó với biến đổi khí hậu
meanings: To undertake resolute, practical actions reducing global warming and atmospheric emissions.
examples: Cities must overhaul building insulation standards to tackle climate change and reduce winter heating demands.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở ra con đường phía trước
meanings: To pioneer sustainable solutions and visionary strategies that guide future community progress.
examples: Transparent scientific collaboration will pave the path forward toward pandemic resilience.

words.general_translation_vi: Khai thác năng lượng thủy triều
meanings: To capture kinetic ocean energy from rising and falling tides for clean electricity generation.
examples: Coastal estuaries provide an optimal geographical setting to harness tidal power with minimal aesthetic disturbance.

words.general_translation_vi: Mang lại góc nhìn mới mẻ cho
meanings: To reveal innovative data or perspectives that illuminate a previously mysterious phenomenon.
examples: Recent archival discoveries have shed fresh light on the diplomatic maneuvers preceding the world conflict.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo lập sự cân bằng mong manh
meanings: To achieve a carefully measured equilibrium between two sensitive or competing objectives.
examples: Policymakers must strike a delicate balance between public safety surveillance and personal civil liberties.

words.general_translation_vi: Gặt hái những lợi ích to lớn
meanings: To gain exceptional rewards, benefits, and positive returns from previous wise investments.
examples: Sustained government investment in primary school STEM training is beginning to reap rich dividends nationwide.

words.general_translation_vi: Khiến cho trở nên lỗi thời
meanings: To make older tools, technologies, or practices completely useless and outdated.
examples: The rapid arrival of solid-state storage quickly rendered obsolete traditional magnetic tape backups.

words.general_translation_vi: Thúc đẩy phục hồi kinh tế
meanings: To trigger, stimulate, and accelerate the resurgence of financial activity following a slump.
examples: Targeted tax cuts for small manufacturing businesses helped spur economic recovery across depressed industrial hubs.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt nguồn từ sự thờ ơ mang tính hệ thống
meanings: To originate directly from chronic, institutional failure to maintain or supervise resources.
examples: The disastrous collapse of the urban aqueduct stems from systemic neglect by previous municipal administrations.

words.general_translation_vi: Rơi vào tầm ngắm bị soi xét kỹ
meanings: To become the focus of deep, critical investigation by auditors, journalists, or authorities.
examples: Pharmaceutical pricing practices have fallen under intense scrutiny following arbitrary increases in insulin costs.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạo ra những rào cản không thể vượt qua
meanings: To create difficulties or barriers that appear virtually impossible to resolve or overcome.
examples: Exorbitant tuition fees pose insurmountable hurdles for talented youths from destitute rural backgrounds.

words.general_translation_vi: Xóa nhòa khoảng cách văn hóa
meanings: To foster mutual appreciation, respect, and dialogue across distinct ethnic backgrounds.
examples: International youth sporting tournaments help bridge cultural divides and dismantle stubborn racial prejudices.

words.general_translation_vi: Hạn chế các khí nhà kính
meanings: To restrict and drastically diminish the volume of heat-trapping gases released into the atmosphere.
examples: Replacing coal-fired power stations with solar arrays is the most rapid strategy to curb greenhouse gases.

words.general_translation_vi: Nuôi dưỡng sự thể hiện sáng tạo
meanings: To encourage individuals to articulate thoughts and artistic impulses openly without fear of censure.
